collection.description: A storm wrecks a generous family's home but spares an unkind neighbor's hut.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A storm destroys the home of a generous family while leaving an unkind neighbor's hut intact.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A survivor refuses to let the storm define their worth.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Wind direction and construction differences shaped the damage.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A mourner questions the fairness of the gods without abandoning faith.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A survey finds no evidence that goodness predicts storm damage.

r2.name: Resolution 2
r2.text: A second witness or unexpected detail complicates the simplest explanation.

r3.name: Resolution 3
r3.text: Another villager interprets the same evidence differently. Their exchange can deepen respect, cause a mild argument, or inspire a shared project.
